source: Sasini Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 September 2025 (FY2025 and the FY2024 comparative), with the FY2023 to FY2021 columns retained from the kenyanstocks.com financial statements API. Note: the FY2024 comparative in the FY2025 annual report was re-represented (Note 39); the stored FY2024 column keeps the figures as originally reported. | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 4 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2021 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2022 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2023 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense); Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Income Tax Credit/(Expense).
